statement: ∀ (U : Set (YEuclid n)) (J : Set ℝ), Set.image2 (@yJoin n) U J = {z : YEuclid (n+1) | yHoriz z ∈ U ∧ yVert z ∈ J}
proof:
have hjoin : (∀ (x : YEuclid n) (t : ℝ), yHoriz (yJoin x t) = x ∧ yVert (yJoin x t) = t) ∧ (∀ z : YEuclid (n+1), yJoin (yHoriz z) (yVert z) = z) := by
  constructor
  · intro x t
    constructor
    · ext i
      simp [yHoriz, yJoin]
    · simp [yVert, yJoin]
  · intro z
    ext i
    refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
    · simp [yJoin, yVert]
    · simp [yJoin, yHoriz]
intro U J
ext z
constructor
· rintro ⟨x, hx, t, ht, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨by simpa only [(hjoin.1 x t).1] using hx, by simpa only [(hjoin.1 x t).2] using ht⟩
· intro hz
  exact ⟨yHoriz z, hz.1, yVert z, hz.2, hjoin.2 z⟩
